name: Pam
description: Drives the bus to the desert once repaired. Glazed yams, mead, and beer suit her straightforward taste.

stardew.intro: Penny's mother, Gus's regular, and the valley's bus driver. Rough around the edges, loyal once you respect her.

relationships.name: Penny
relationships.note: Lives with her daughter in the trailer — tough love on both sides.

relationships.name: Gus
relationships.note: Evening regular at the Stardrop Saloon.

trivia: Repair the community center or Joja bus to unlock Desert trips — and more time with Pam at the wheel.
